edits.description: Retained the complete PutRgn module and applicable original comments. Omitted the later EASE header.
Replaced the GrafTypes include with its required equates and their dependencies. Retained the original procedure parameters and local EQU declarations.
Made PC operands, branch sizes and applicable ADDQ or SUBQ encodings explicit. Matched source branches to ROM branches in order; every branch condition agrees.
Retained the UNLINK invocation and supplied the restored 68000 return macro used by the reconstructed Regions module.
Assigned external procedure addresses from the matching ROM call operands. Preserved the original symbolic call names.

Restored two MOVE.L (A0)+,(A1)+ instructions for rectangular regions. The ROM copies the two diagonal bounding-box points. The ancestor adds six instructions to emit all four corners and records the rectangular-region fix on September 26, 1986. Removed the later change tags; retained the COPY TOPLEFT and COPY BOTRIGHT comment wording.

verification.result: All 118 assembled bytes equal the ROM span. All 1 recorded symbols match their addresses.
verification.method: Used the shared translator on the preserved source, assembled for the 68000, linked at the ROM address, checked for unresolved relocations and compared every byte with the ROM.
limitations: MPW assembly has not been run.
Byte equality does not establish the original macro spelling, source formatting or label spelling.
